name: Relationship Astrology Consultation
purpose: Both natal charts, examined together — an honest gauge of compatibility: where affinity flows, where friction lives, and how each of you communicates and feels cared for.
method: Synastry analysis of the interaction between both natal charts: areas of affinity and inharmonious areas highlighted and discussed, including each person's communication style and what makes each feel secure.
bestFor: Any two people seeking to bond in a constructive way — couples, partners, close pairs
Understanding why the connection feels the way it feels
Decreasing the effects of obstacles you already sense
notFor: A verdict on whether to stay or go — the charts describe dynamics; the choice remains yours
Reading someone's chart without their knowledge — both parties' presence is preferred
intakeRequirements: Birth date, exact time, and place for both people
The relationship context and your questions
includes: The interaction between both natal charts — a gauge of compatibility
Areas of affinity and inharmonious areas, highlighted and discussed
How each person prefers to communicate, and what makes each feel cared for and secure

preparation: Gather accurate birth data for both people — ideally from birth certificates
